title: Chapter 251: Zerg Army'S Defensive Operation
content:
Chapter 251: Zerg Army'S Defensive Operation

Wu Qing knew that the ultimate goal of the alien race was the Zerg destroyers, but the Zerg army had to stop marching in the face of the increasing attacks and launched a fierce counterattack against the armies commanded by the alien race.

"Boom boom boom...!"

"Boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers and Zerg dragons began to fire at full force.

The goblins and other affiliated races of the alien race who continued to launch a strong attack on the Zerg army suffered a large number of casualties.

GOOGLE search TWKAN

The Zerg army encountered a major battle before it reached the 66th city.

The newly joined armies of the alien races were all star-level soldiers, mixed in with the goblins, and charged the Zerg army.

The troops they joined in the battle one after another also amounted to nearly two million.

Wu Qing guessed that in addition to the army of the alien race itself, the armies of other alien races in this area should have been sent over.

The Zerg army was at an absolute disadvantage in terms of manpower, but it had an absolute advantage in terms of strength.

The enemy's star-level soldiers joined the battle, and the five-star Zerg Destroyers in the Zerg army joined the battle. Under their attack, the star-level soldiers were no different from ordinary goblins. With one shot, the entire explosion range was completely cleared.

For the enemies that rushed to the nearby, the Zerg Hydralisk began to fire armor-piercing spikes, and cooperated with the Zerg biodegradation liquid to quickly eliminate the enemies.

Zerg cockroaches and Zerg stealth spiders also began to join the battle.

The flame attack of the Zerg cockroaches and the armor-piercing ground spike attack of the Zerg stealth spiders can effectively reduce the pressure of the Zerg Hydralisk.

In addition to the melee Zerg puppies, there are also Zerg queens, Zerg explosive mosquitoes, five-star Zerg Hydralisks, Zerg dragons, and other Zerg combat soldiers, all participated in the defensive operations.

This blocking battle commanded by the aliens, which was intended to create an opportunity for the Light Griffin Knights to raid the Zerg Destroyers, turned into a large-scale defensive operation of the Zerg army.

The Zerg army has a battle to fight, and Wu Qing will certainly not refuse anyone. The system now has no shortage of resources, and no matter what tricks the alien race plays, he can play with them.

Although the Zerg army of more than 900,000 soldiers is not large, as long as they are willing to invest resources and continue to upgrade these Zerg armies, they will be an invincible and powerful army.

Wu Qing is not in a hurry to upgrade the Zerg army because the Zerg units can be restored to their peak state in all aspects after a star-level upgrade.

For this reason, if the Zerg army has enough combat power, the Zerg army can be consumed first, and then upgraded when necessary.

This can greatly increase the sustained combat capability of this Zerg army.

There is also a flying army among the affiliated races of the alien races, which is a medium-sized bird creature that Wu Qing has never seen.

When the Zerg army destroyed nearly half of the affiliated races of the alien races, the flying army, which numbered only more than 10,000, suddenly split into several branches and launched a surprise attack on the Zerg army from different directions.

They are all believers of the Lord of Light, and they also have powerful light magic. They rushed to the sky above the Zerg Destroyer under the attacks of the Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Mutalisk, trying to attack the Zerg Destroyer.

There are constantly large birds covered in white light falling from the sky under the attacks of the Zerg Hydralisk's armor-piercing spikes and the Zerg Mutalisk's biological bombs.

The Lord of Light's light magic is indeed powerful. The attacks of the two-star Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Mutalisk have limited killing effects on the incoming large birds.

Under the protection of the light magic, there are still many large birds rushing through the air defense network of the Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Mutalisk at high speed.

Since the five-star Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Mutalisk did not take action, the main forces of the Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Mutalisk went to attack other alien human armies, and there were not many troops defending around the Zerg Destroyer.

In addition to the attacks of the Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Mutalisks that participated in the air defense, Wu Qing deliberately let them go, allowing thousands of big birds to successfully break through the Zerg's air defense firepower and launch an attack on the Zerg destroyers.

The believers of the Lord of Light have all become creatures of light attributes, and their attacks are the same no matter how they change.

A large area of light attribute energy attacks with purification and annihilation effects fell on the attacking Zerg destroyers, causing many Zerg destroyers to lose their attack capabilities directly.

These big birds were about to continue attacking, but the Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Mutalisks that were chasing them shot them all down with armor-piercing spikes and biological bombs.

This was a test attack, and the flying arms that successfully broke through the defense line gave the aliens hope.

It is estimated that the aliens will mobilize all the troops that can be quickly mobilized. At this time, the battle on the battlefield has been quite fierce. The main forces of the Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Mutalisks have been mobilized for defensive operations. If they delay any further, the offensive of the alien army will begin to weaken.

The final attack of the aliens finally began.

Through the vision of the Zerg host, Wu Qing saw nearly 100,000 flying soldiers who had just raided the Zerg destroyers flying from afar.

More than a thousand light griffon knights mixed in with the big birds covered in white light and flew towards the Zerg army.

This time, the flying soldiers of the aliens flew near the Zerg army, without splitting up, but gathered together, accelerated directly, and rushed towards the Zerg army.

The Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Dragons of the Zerg army immediately abandoned their original defensive combat missions and switched to air defense at an extremely fast speed.

The ground defense operations were handed over to the Zerg cockroaches that had not played a role. With the help of the Zerg destroyers and Zerg stealth spiders with truly unreserved firepower, and the Zerg puppies that had never taken action, the armies and goblins of the alien race's affiliated races wanted to rush up, but they would definitely not be able to do so in a short time.

Under the command of Wu Qing, two thousand five-star Zerg destroyers suddenly turned around and launched a round of attacks on the high-speed flying alien soldiers.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Two thousand powerful liquid fireball shells rushed at the large flock of birds flying at high speed at a very high speed. Even if the flying ability of a flock of one hundred thousand birds gathered together and flew at high speed was very strong, it was almost impossible for all members to avoid two thousand high-speed shells.

"Boom boom!"

More than half of the liquid fireball shells exploded in the flying arms of the aliens. The attack power of the five-star Zerg destroyer was huge. Large flocks of birds fell from the sky, and many of them disappeared directly.

Ordinary Zerg destroyers are definitely not efficient for air defense. The liquid fireball shells they eject are not fast enough. With the powerful flying skills of the flying arms, it is easy to dodge them.

However, the flying speed of the liquid fireball shells fired by the Zerg destroyer with a five-star strength has been greatly improved. It is definitely not possible to attack a small number of flying arms, but it is still feasible to attack a large number of flying arms flying densely.

In Wu Qing's first attempt, although nearly half of the attacks of the five-star Zerg destroyers were avoided, it was a bit wasteful, but the comprehensive killing efficiency of their attacks was still very high.

With the attack speed of the five-star Zerg destroyers, they can still launch another round of attacks before the alien flying soldiers rush over.

Obviously, the alien flying soldiers are also aware of this problem. Their formations are forced to spread out and distance themselves from each other to facilitate avoiding attacks and reduce the probability of being hit.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The attacks of the five-star Zerg destroyers came as expected. Because the alien flying soldiers were prepared, the hit rate of these attacks was lower.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Amid the explosion, the surviving alien flying soldiers moved together again and rushed into the defense circle of the Zerg Hydralisk and Zerg Dragon.

In the case of not having an advantage in manpower, the more scattered they are, the easier it is to be attacked one by one by the enemy with superior manpower.

And by concentrating as much as possible and attacking from one direction, the enemy's large number of air defense forces can be ineffective.

Under the enemy's limited air defense firepower, the probability of success will definitely be much greater if a large number of troops are used to concentrate and break through.

This tactic of the Terran flying troops is indeed very effective. Only some of the Zerg Hydralisks in the Zerg army can carry out effective armor-piercing spike attacks, while some can spray Zerg biological decomposition fluid for auxiliary attacks.

Most of the Zerg Hydralisks are scattered throughout the Zerg army and have no way to attack the Terran flying troops in the raid.

Unless all of the Zerg Dragons rush up for close combat, only some of them can carry out effective long-range attacks.

The two thousand five-star Zerg Hydralisks and two thousand five-star Zerg Dragons guarding the Zerg Destroyer finally opened fire, and a large number of Terran flying troops fell down like rain.

Now that the fish has been hooked, the Terran Light Griffin Knights have flown over, and Wu Qing does not need to hold back.

The thousands of Terran Light Griffin Knights following far behind are a big threat. When they really rush into the attack range of the Zerg army, they are not so scary. At most, they will lose some Zerg Destroyers.

Twenty five-star Zerg Exploding Swarms rushed out of the Zerg Dragons like lightning and rushed into the flying arms of the Alien Terrans. The Light Griffin Knights hiding in them sensed the danger and wanted to intercept them, but the attack speed of the five-star Zerg Exploding Swarms was too fast and they didn't give them any chance at all.

The Light Griffin Knights knew the power of the Zerg Exploding Swarms' self-explosion and could only choose to dodge!

When the Light Griffin Knights left the big birds that were blocking them, two hundred of them were attacked by the Zerg Queen's spawning attack!

The Light Griffin Knights were reduced in number when they were exposed, which was a loss within the budget of the Alien Terrans, but the number of two hundred was much more than they had budgeted.

"Boom...!"

Twenty five-star Zerg Exploding Swarms rushed to different positions and exploded almost at the same time!

The terrifying explosions overlapped and almost cleared the sky where the Alien Terrans' flying arms were located, leaving thousands of Light Griffin Knights without any cover.
